Grad Program
This could be you!
Apply to our Ph.D. Program Here
Apply Now!
UF Chemistry offers a dynamic and rigorous graduate program designed to prepare students for successful careers in academia, industry, and government. Our Ph.D. program provides comprehensive training across all major areas of chemistry, including analytical, chemical biology, inorganic, organic, and physical, with opportunities for interdisciplinary research and collaboration including bioimaging, AI and machine learning, and polymer chemistry. Graduate students work closely with internationally recognized faculty, have access to state-of-the-art research facilities, and benefit from a supportive and inclusive academic community. With a strong focus on innovation, professional development, and scientific leadership, UF Chemistry equips students with the skills and experience needed to make impactful contributions to the chemical sciences.
